issues.description: The problem statement/UML and the reference solution disagree on the return type of messageOnMilk(): the UML interface (and a sentence in the text) specify a boolean return type (messageOnMilk(): boolean / "return true if milking was successful, false otherwise"), while the Seal/Goat class blocks in the UML and the provided solution implement messageOnMilk() as returning String. The solution's Milkable interface and implementations return String and the template Main prints the result of messageOnMilk(), which implies a String value. This inconsistency will confuse students about whether to implement messageOnMilk() to return a boolean or a String and will make either the solution or the students' implementations incompatible with the specification/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the specification and the solution. Either: (A) Change the problem statement/UML and explanatory text to specify messageOnMilk(): String (and describe the returned String format, e.g. "[AnimalType] [name] is milked") so it matches the solution and the template Main which prints the value; or (B) Change the solution (Milkable interface and Seal/Goat implementations) to return boolean and update Main and any tests to handle boolean results. Prefer option A to preserve the existing solution behavior and the fact that Main prints the milking message.
